lines.6: 「...I-I was really looking forward to our date with the girls from Midorioka Academy...」
lines.7: 「Damn it! I was going to use Subaru to lure the girls in, put Igaguri beside me as a comparison, and become irresistible. Even Zhuge Liang would marvel at a perfect plan like that!」
lines.8: 「Hey, Fukahire. We've already got these free amusement-park tickets. Why don't the two of us go?」
lines.9: 「At times like this, you gotta play and blow off some steam.」
lines.11: 「I like Ferris wheels. Let's ride one together.」
lines.12: 「Ghk... A date with Igaguri, just the two of us!?」
lines.13: 「W-well, whatever. Days like this happen. I bet Leo and Subaru are spending their day in pretty much the same situation as me.」
